def words_appearing_once(text):
    counts = Counter(text.split())
    once = [word for word, c in counts.items() if c == 1]
    once.sort()
    return once

    if len(s) < 2 or not s[:-1].isdigit() or not s[-1].isdigit():

    plus = sum(int(d) for d in body[0::2])

    return int(s[-1]) == (plus - minus) % 10

def median_upper(nums):
    n = len(nums)
    k = n // 2 + 1
    smallest_k = heapq.nsmallest(k, nums)
    return smallest_k[-1]
